job_ready_complete.name: job_ready_complete
job_ready_complete.value: "job"."status" <> 'ready' or ("job"."company_id" is not null and "job"."title" is not null and length(trim("job"."title")) > 0)

job_salary_order.name: job_salary_order
job_salary_order.value: "job"."salary_min" is null or "job"."salary_max" is null or "job"."salary_min" <= "job"."salary_max"

story_parts_not_empty.name: story_parts_not_empty
story_parts_not_empty.value: length(trim("story"."title")) > 0 and length(trim("story"."situation")) > 0 and length(trim("story"."task")) > 0 and length(trim("story"."action")) > 0 and length(trim("story"."result")) > 0

funnel_message_classified_complete.name: funnel_message_classified_complete
funnel_message_classified_complete.value: "funnel_message"."status" <> 'classified' or ("funnel_message"."kind" is not null and "funnel_message"."company" is not null and "funnel_message"."classified_by" is not null)

search_preference_thresholds.name: search_preference_thresholds
search_preference_thresholds.value: "search_preference"."suggest_at" between 0 and 100 and "search_preference"."queue_at" between 0 and 100 and "search_preference"."suggest_at" <= "search_preference"."queue_at"

search_preference_comp_order.name: search_preference_comp_order
search_preference_comp_order.value: "search_preference"."comp_floor" is null or "search_preference"."comp_target" is null or "search_preference"."comp_floor" <= "search_preference"."comp_target"

approval_decision_policy_fields.name: approval_decision_policy_fields
approval_decision_policy_fields.value:
("approval_decision"."decided_by" = 'policy' and "approval_decision"."decision" = 'approved' and "approval_decision"."policy_set_id" is not null and "approval_decision"."rule_name" is not null)
        or ("approval_decision"."decided_by" = 'user' and "approval_decision"."policy_set_id" is null and "approval_decision"."rule_name" is null)

apply_submission_reason_valid.name: apply_submission_reason_valid
apply_submission_reason_valid.value:
("apply_submission"."status" = 'needs_human' and "apply_submission"."reason" in ('captcha', 'login', 'mfa', 'account', 'unmapped_required', 'form_changed', 'no_confirmation', 'driver_error', 'outcome_unknown', 'status_conflict'))
        or ("apply_submission"."status" <> 'needs_human' and "apply_submission"."reason" is null)

vault_secret_sizes.name: vault_secret_sizes
vault_secret_sizes.value:
octet_length("vault_secret"."wrapped_key_iv") = 12 and octet_length("vault_secret"."iv") = 12
        and octet_length("vault_secret"."wrapped_key_tag") = 16 and octet_length("vault_secret"."tag") = 16
        and octet_length("vault_secret"."wrapped_key") = 32 and octet_length("vault_secret"."ciphertext") >= 1

mail_link_linked_or_queued.name: mail_link_linked_or_queued
mail_link_linked_or_queued.value:
("mail_link"."application_id" is not null and "mail_link"."step" in ('tag', 'thread', 'sender') and "mail_link"."queue_reason" is null)
        or ("mail_link"."application_id" is null and "mail_link"."step" is null and "mail_link"."sender_verified" = false
            and "mail_link"."queue_reason" in ('unknown_tag', 'ambiguous', 'no_match'))

resume_audit_decision_valid.name: resume_audit_decision_valid
resume_audit_decision_valid.value:
("resume_audit_decision"."decision" = 'accepted' and "resume_audit_decision"."new_line" is not null and length(trim("resume_audit_decision"."new_line")) > 0)
        or ("resume_audit_decision"."decision" = 'rejected' and "resume_audit_decision"."new_line" is null)

independent_work_entry_link_https.name: independent_work_entry_link_https
independent_work_entry_link_https.value: "independent_work_entry"."link" is null or ("independent_work_entry"."link" ~ '^https://' and length("independent_work_entry"."link") <= 300 and "independent_work_entry"."link" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

growth_settings_ranges.name: growth_settings_ranges
growth_settings_ranges.value: "growth_settings"."weekly_minutes" between 0 and 10080 and "growth_settings"."wip_limit" between 1 and 10 and "growth_settings"."block_minutes" between 15 and 90 and "growth_settings"."maintenance_minutes" between 15 and 90 and "growth_settings"."min_focus_sessions" between 1 and 7

growth_track_goal_shape.name: growth_track_goal_shape
growth_track_goal_shape.value: "growth_track"."goal" is null or (length(trim("growth_track"."goal")) between 1 and 300 and "growth_track"."goal" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

growth_track_done_when_shape.name: growth_track_done_when_shape
growth_track_done_when_shape.value: "growth_track"."done_when" is null or (length(trim("growth_track"."done_when")) between 1 and 300 and "growth_track"."done_when" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

growth_track_next_title_shape.name: growth_track_next_title_shape
growth_track_next_title_shape.value: "growth_track"."next_title" is null or (length(trim("growth_track"."next_title")) between 1 and 200 and "growth_track"."next_title" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

growth_track_next_pair.name: growth_track_next_pair
growth_track_next_pair.value: ("growth_track"."next_title" is null) = ("growth_track"."next_minutes" is null) and ("growth_track"."next_minutes" is null or "growth_track"."next_minutes" >= 1)

profile_contact_phone_shape.name: profile_contact_phone_shape
profile_contact_phone_shape.value: "profile_contact"."phone" IS NULL OR char_length("profile_contact"."phone") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

recruiter_grade_reasons_listed.name: recruiter_grade_reasons_listed
recruiter_grade_reasons_listed.value: cardinality("recruiter_grade"."reasons") between 1 and 12 and array_position("recruiter_grade"."reasons", null) is null and "recruiter_grade"."reasons" <@ array['title:exact', 'title:partial', 'title:none', 'title:unknown', 'title:level_mismatch', 'pay:ok', 'pay:below', 'pay:unknown', 'place:ok', 'place:mismatch', 'place:unknown', 'sender:agency', 'sender:in_house', 'sender:unknown', 'personal:yes', 'personal:no', 'company:named', 'company:unnamed', 'dealbreaker', 'red_flag:upfront_fee', 'red_flag:sensitive_data', 'red_flag:vague_role', 'red_flag:unpaid_work']::text[]
